items.title: Earl Foster Interview
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Mani Gabriel directly; the name is only introduced by the interviewer in the context of a band lineup ('Before Mani Gabriel').

ctx.x: Let me see. Yeah, you said that Isidro Prince played with him a while too. Before Mani Gabriel. That's right.

Isidro Prince played with him too, yes. But before Mani, Isidro Prince. Did Isidro Prince come over on the side? Yes, indeed. That's the buffum over the lake I'm talking about. He came over there? Yeah. Yeah. He played for me to go over there and play.
Oh, I remember somebody told me once that Buddy used to play a lot across the lake too. Sometime.
